explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 63 named tracks across roughly fourteen releases and release roundups: current September UK-club and electronic listings, emerging deep-techno artists on Mojuba/a.r.t.less, and overlooked a.r.t.less/Matrix catalogue material. Written attributed descriptions and exact listings only; no audio audition.
exclusions: Completed Runs 210, 211, 213, 214 and 217 source fields and selected identities were excluded; failed Run 212 identities were not reused.

Every exact artist/title pair below was checked against the canonical ledger, target discoveries, local discovery pool, active rejections, PARKED revisit queue and global utility ledger before ranking; none was present.
The repetition check compared the previous five completed discovery runs (210, 211, 213, 214 and 217). None of the nine placements repeats a selected-candidate boundary from those runs.

Nine honest leads survived without padding. The protected Transparency → When We Froze → Stardancer internal order and both protected handoffs remain untouched. No Spotify connector, raw audio, invented identity or metadata-to-feeling inference was used.
